models_evaluated: Fully automated AI-driven diabetes prevention program (Lark DPP)

links.outcome: Patient preference for human coach versus fully automated AI program
links.effect: 46.5% of AI-assigned participants would have preferred a human coach vs 31.5% preferring a fully automated program in the human-led group (p = 0.012).
links.quote: Preference responses also favored human coaching, with 46.5% of AI-assigned participants indicating they would have preferred a human coach compared with 31.5% preferring a fully automated program in the human-led group ( p = 0.012).

unlisted_practices: Comparing fully automated AI lifestyle coaching with human coaching on engagement, acceptability, and preference in an RCT

screen.reason: Phase 3 randomized controlled trial evaluating patient engagement, acceptability, and preferences for an AI-led diabetes prevention program versus human coaching in real patients.
